tolerances.acceptance_rule: Every numeric field must satisfy both max_abs and RMS limits over one step and the entire short rollout in both scenarios; every exact/mask/action-conversion limit must also pass. Tolerances must not be changed after measurement under this declaration ID.

scenarios.determinism: The saved DR patch, reset seed, push interval draws, and push velocity draws are replayed from the same seeded environment RNG stream.
scenarios.name: deterministic_nontrivial_dr
